title: SPXI entity inscription: scoring, Portuna conformance and basin tracking
description: SPXI as a service: #673 (April 2026) specifies scoring semantic presence across five instruments before structured data is written and holds that supraliminal signals resist model-weight drift; #670 holds that the protocol run without its concept drifts; #621 specifies a phased build sequence; and #672 forecasts a DOI-anchored sign that need not be paid for again. The Portuna deposits (#135, #1446) specify boolean conformance predicates for state transitions and surfaces, and #135 names heteronym collapse as a risk. The Living Architecture Lab and Alice Thornburgh packets (#709, #980) specify basin tracking with a hardening cycle when drift exceeds threshold.

- Register domain
- Build landing page (problem → solution → proof → contact)

**Phase 1: Core API (Months 2–4)**

- TrackedObject schema implemented
- Create, trace, status, review, fix endpoints
- PostgreSQL + Redis deployment
- API key authentication
- Free tier live
